backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the Painting and SiteContent data types, CRUD operations for paintings, user profiles, and site content, with admin-only access control enforced via AccessControl mixin.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two implemented features—admin painting action buttons and visual SOLD indicators—to their relevant source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, serving as a reference index for the project's React component and hook structure.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including background, foreground, primary, destructive, and sidebar variables.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell titled 'Dark Predictions Paintings' that mounts the React app into a root div and loads the main TypeScript entry point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with routes for the gallery, painting detail, and admin dashboard (guarded by AdminRouteGuard), wrapped in a dark-themed layout with header, footer, and toaster.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminPaint: A form component for adding or editing a painting, handling image uploads with progress tracking, and submitting data via add/update mutations with toast notifications.
Displays a table of paintings with options to edit, delete, and toggle sold status, including loading skeletons and a confirmation dialog for deletion.
frontend/src/components/admin/SiteConten: A form for editing site content fields (hero headline, subtitle, mission statement, contact email) that loads existing data and saves updates via a mutation.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access denied card with options to log in or return to the gallery, adapting its message based on whether the user is authenticated.
frontend/src/components/auth/AdminRouteG: A route guard that shows a loading skeleton while checking admin access, then renders children or the AccessDeniedScreen based on authentication and admin status.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: A button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, clearing the React Query cache on logout and showing a loading spinner during login.
Contact CTA component that fetches the contact email from site content and renders either a mailto button for available paintings or a 'This painting has been sold' notice when the disabled prop is set.
frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.ts: Renders the site footer with branding, a contact email sourced from site content (with a fallback constant), and a mission statement.
frontend/src/components/layout/Header.ts: Renders the sticky site header with a logo link, an admin navigation button visible only to authenticated admins, and the LoginButton component.
frontend/src/components/MissionStatement: Section component that fetches and displays the mission statement from backend site content, showing loading skeletons while fetching and falling back to a hardcoded default string.
frontend/src/components/PaintingCard.tsx: Gallery card component that renders a painting's image with a diagonal SOLD stamp overlay and brightness dimming, a red SOLD badge in the card body, and a strikethrough price with 'No longer available' label for sold paintings.
frontend/src/constants/contact.ts: Defines a fallback contact email constant and a helper function to build a mailto link with subject and body parameters.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, reinitializing it when the Internet Identity changes and invalidating dependent queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAccess.ts: A hook that combines Internet Identity authentication state with the caller's user role to expose isAuthenticated, isAdmin, and isLoading flags.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including CRUD operations for paintings, site content management, and user role retrieval.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines light/dark mode CSS custom properties for the design system's color tokens.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboardPage.ts: Admin dashboard page with tabbed interface for managing paintings (add/edit/delete) and editing site content, using dialogs for painting forms.
frontend/src/pages/GalleryPage.tsx: Public gallery page displaying a hero section with dynamic site content, a mission statement, and a responsive grid of painting cards with loading skeletons.
frontend/src/pages/PaintingDetailPage.ts: Detail page for a single painting showing an image carousel or single image with a sold overlay, price, description, and a contact CTA.
frontend/src/utils/format.ts: Utility function that converts a bigint price in cents to a formatted USD currency string.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with helpers to persist, retrieve, and clear those values using sessionStorage.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom theme tokens (colors via oklch variables, fonts, border radii, shadows, animations) and enabling the typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state manifest (version 5) for an art portfolio/gallery app, tracking existing features (admin painting list actions, sold indicators) and pending feature requests around admin edit/delete/sold-status functionality.
